title: Add Infinite Scroll
content: Create infinite scroll. Container: overflow-y-auto max-h-[600px]. Content: items list, rendered from data. Sentinel: div at bottom observed with IntersectionObserver. Loading: when sentinel visible, fetch more data, show spinner. End state: "No more items" message when all loaded.

variants.simple: Create infinite scroll list that loads more on scroll.
variants.detailed: Create infinite scroll. Container: overflow-y-auto max-h-[600px]. Content: items list, rendered from data. Sentinel: div at bottom observed with IntersectionObserver. Loading: when sentinel visible, fetch more data, show spinner. End state: "No more items" message when all loaded.
variants.advanced: Create robust infinite scroll component. Scroll container: parent with overflow scroll, or window scroll. Sentinel element: invisible div after last item, observed with IntersectionObserver (rootMargin for early trigger). Load trigger: when sentinel intersects, call loadMore if not loading and hasMore. Loading states: initial load (skeleton list), loading more (spinner at bottom), error (retry button), no more (end message or hide). Performance: throttle/debounce scroll handling, use CSS containment. Virtual scrolling: for very long lists, only render visible items + buffer (react-virtual/react-window). Item rendering: render prop or component prop for flexibility. Loading indicator: spinner, skeleton items, or custom. Error handling: show error message with retry button, exponential backoff. Bi-directional: optional load older items when scrolling to top (chat-style). Restore position: remember scroll position on back navigation. Pull to refresh: optional at top (mobile). Item count: optionally show "Showing X of Y items". Scroll to top: button appears when scrolled down. Keyboard: focus management for accessibility. Analytics: track scroll depth. Reset: method to reset list and start fresh. Caching: integrate with React Query/SWR for data caching.
